Mad Labs upholds strict quality control standards, ensuring that every cartridge is third-party lab-tested for potency, purity, and safety. Every batch undergoes extensive testing to verify that the oil is free from pesticides, residual solvents, heavy metals, and contaminants.

Mad Labs Quality Assurance:
